audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 4, 5 and 6 disagreed with packet.levelChart (Poppy at 6, Warwick at first item and 2+ items) and with the whys, which say his first bruiser item starts his takeover.
audit.why: The chart gave Poppy the first-item and 2-item rows in a 45.53% win-rate matchup whose own text says he out-scales.
audit.corrected: Rows 4, 5, 6 flipped as matched full+content pairs with ratings updated.

audit.why: Level 6 is genuinely Poppy's: Infinite Duress is a 110/90/70s channelled leap and her E stun interrupts it. First item onward is his on Blood Hunt and Q lifesteal.
audit.corrected: Level 6 and first-item whys now state those reasons rather than boilerplate.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Warwick ability was named in the full layer (packet defect), and Primal Howl was completely absent — both its 2.5s damage reduction and its 1-second fear.
audit.why: Primal Howl's fear is hard CC that cancels Poppy's Keeper's Verdict channel, and its damage reduction blunts exactly the burst window she is told to take. Jaws of the Beast is a dash, so Steadfast Presence stops it. Jaws deals max-health damage and heals off it, so armour does not blunt the trade — Grievous Wounds does.
audit.corrected: Primal Howl's timers, the Q dash-grounding, and the max-health/anti-heal point are now stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: The tracked cooldown was Infinite Duress alone, with no number.
audit.why: Primal Howl (15/14/13/12/11s) is the cooldown that decides lane trades; Infinite Duress at 110s decides all-ins.
audit.corrected: Both cooldowns now stated where the advice depends on them.

edits.before: Keeper’s Verdict punts the fight’s biggest threat across the map. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Warwick's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Keeper's Verdict punts him away and your E stun cancels Infinite Duress mid-leap — your best level, so fight while his 110s R is spent.

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Infinite Duress's cooldown.
edits.after: His first bruiser item turns on Blood Hunt chase and Q lifesteal — stop forcing, farm and hold your R.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Warwick carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: He out-sustains you: max-health Q lifesteal plus a passive that triples under 25%. Peel and disengage — never take the extended duel.

edits.before: E Warwick into a wall when his answer is down, Q the zone under him, and W any dash he tries — his mobility is a suggestion.
edits.after: E him into a wall while Primal Howl (15s) is down, Q the zone under him, and W his Jaws of the Beast lunge to ground him.

edits.before: E-ing with no wall behind him — the wall-stun is the whole trade; the dash alone is a tickle.
edits.after: Brawling under 50% HP — Eternal Hunger heals him off every auto, and it triples below 25%.

edits.before: His all-in suppress. E-peel around it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Infinite Duress suppresses 1.5s on a 110s cooldown. Your E stun cancels it.

edits.before: E Warwick into a wall when his answer is down, Q the zone under him, and W any dash he tries — his mobility is a suggestion.
edits.after: Jaws of the Beast heals off max-health damage, so armour does not blunt it — buy Grievous Wounds before the extended trades, not after.

edits.before: Warwick wastes Infinite Duress — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Primal Howl's fear cancels your R channel — E-stun him first, then Q.

edits.before: That is Warwick's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Blood Hunt triples his speed and attack speed on you under 25% — never linger.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: His Q heal repays the whole trade before your Q zone detonates.

edits.before: E-ing with no wall behind him — the wall-stun is the whole trade; the dash alone is a tickle.
edits.after: Under 50% his passive heals off every hit, and Primal Howl eats 2.5 seconds of your damage.

edits.before: Track Warwick's Infinite Duress: His all-in suppress. E-peel around it. When it is down — E-Q + R him.
edits.after: Infinite Duress suppresses 1.5s; your E stun cancels the leap. Primal Howl's fear cancels your R.

notes: Primal Howl was absent from the entire page despite being the ability that both blunts Poppy's burst (2.5s damage reduction) and cancels her Keeper's Verdict channel (1s fear). Chart rows 4-6 disagreed with packet.levelChart and with the whys; flipped as one paired group.
